name: ISG 5501
title: Genetic Counseling Fieldwork Rotation I - Spring First Year
description: The first of six experiential supervised fieldwork placements applying genetic counseling theory from the classroom to practical clinical and non-clinical professional settings to support the development of genetic counseling practice-based competencies.
requirement_description: Open to graduate genetic counseling Professional Science Master's students who have completed the first semester of the program. Corequisite: ISG 5502.
